articleTitle: The Adoption of Activity-Based Costing and Contextual, Organizational and Behavioural Factors: Evidence from Sudan
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Data Analytics for Business and Industry (ICDABI)
abstract: This study contributes to the existing knowledge by investigating the extent of the adoption of activity-based costing as well as the influence of contextual, organizational and behavioural factors on ABC adoption in the context of developing countries, especially in Sudan. The data were collected from a sample of Sudanese manufacturing companies listed in the Ministry of Industry with a response rate of 76%. The findings indicate that the ABC adoption rate is about 42.1%. The results indicate that significant progress in updating cost and management information systems and adopting ABC compared to what it used to be, even though most companies are still using traditional techniques. Additionally, the study found that all the factors examined were significantly associated with the adoption of ABC. Particularly, the existence of a costing system was the most important factor that impact the adoption of ABC in SMCs. The study also confirms the critical role of organizational and behavioural factors with organizational support and adequacy of resources on ABC adoption.

articleTitle: Data Science in Education: Applications and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Data Analytics for Business and Industry (ICDABI)
abstract: In today’s technology environment, big data is a catchphrase that everyone is talking about. Most traditional pedagogies offer students limited timely feedback, require lecturers and teachers to spend hours grading routine assignments. These pedagogies fail in integrating ample digital resources and are not potent to enhance students’ understanding. Data has enormous potential to enhance research, decision making, and lifelong learning. The combination of complex disciplines of computer science and statistics with social science philosophy in education data science aims to study more about how students learn and interact in the educational environment with real-time data collection. Despite its infancy, the wide availability of educational data has spurred an interest in analyzing relevant knowledge to guide educational policy and practice. This paper discusses the applications of data science in education field as well as the challenges for future development.

articleTitle: Hiding and Exposing Messages by Covert Channel Features
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Data Analytics for Business and Industry (ICDABI)
abstract: a covert channel is a dangerous communication channel classified as an invisible and undetected security attack. Furthermore, in the different networks, there are several concerns about the packets while transmitting the message on the internet. Especially if there is a hiding data algorithm used to protect the system. Detecting systems can be done using several sectors like machine learning or using special scripting algorithms to hide these data. Based on this research content, the provided idea is that it is worth securing the transmission of packets by using covert channel features to hide the messages in the network between two parties to have a high-security level of protection. Dealing with a covert channel is to concentrates on traffic tunneling or encryption, which is a famous network security method. Furthermore, transmission using channels according to conditions for hiding the data will make the system secure and the user feels safe to send any data which cannot be tracked. Although, the feature of hiding data by using the covert channel is the absolute sense of having protecting system while using a network. Covert channels are used to make information in any transmission hidden, and use the system in save and protected mode always. The focus of the paper is a review about what is the covert channel and an example of hiding data in image type using s-Tool implementing encryption feature while transmitting the data via the internet.

articleTitle: Secure Transaction Framework based on Encrypted One-time Password and Multi-factor
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Data Analytics for Business and Industry (ICDABI)
abstract: This paper presents a secure transaction framework for money transactions. A qualitative study is taken into consideration as the goal of the research. The proposed framework ensures a secure money transaction and is based on multi-factor Encrypting One Time Password (EOTP) that have a strong authentication method and overcome the weakness found in One Time Password (OTP) and EOTP methods. The proposed framework is analyzed against different attacks encountered by OTP and EOTP and is found to be effective and secure.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity Risks on Health Sector Social Media: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2021 International Conference on Data Analytics for Business and Industry (ICDABI)
abstract: Social media took a big part of society; along with it came the rising of cybercrime and its effect on society and users of social networking sites. Cybercrime has opened new doors for criminals to expand their practices to the network environment, including many individuals who know the social media environment’s ins and outs. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the literature on the cybersecurity risks in the healthcare sector Social Media to recognize the existing knowledge on this subject. Applying a systematic and precise method emphasizes the needy consideration ways of avoiding cybersecurity risks. Future studies should empirically examine the cybersecurity risks on health care sector social media contributing an applied result.
